import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec

fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 2,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.52,
    wspace=0.32,
    left=0.06, right=0.97,
    top=0.91, bottom=0.05,
    height_ratios=[0.9, 1.1, 1.0]
)

# ── Title ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.97, "Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 → 2024",
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DK,
         fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')
fig.text(0.5, 0.938, "Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) — communicable, non-communicable, and injury categories",
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=12, color=TEXT_MD)

legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_COMM, label='Communicable'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_NCD,  label='NCD'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_INJ,  label='Injury'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.97, 0.965),
           ncol=3, fontsize=11, frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
           edgecolor=GRID_C, facecolor=PANEL_BG)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PANEL A  – Grouped stacked bars: global category totals 1990 vs 2024

    2024: {"Communicable":  612.5, "NCD": 1487.3, "Injury": 308.6},
}
years = [1990, 2024]
bar_w = 0.42
x = np.array([0.0, 1.0])

bottoms = np.zeros(2)
order = ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
for cat in order:
    vals = [totals[y][cat] for y in years]
    bars = ax_a.bar(x, vals, bar_w, bottom=bottoms, color=CAT_COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    for i, (b, v) in enumerate(zip(bottoms, vals)):
        mid = b + v / 2
        pct = v / sum(totals[years[i]].values()) * 100
        ax_a.text(x[i], mid, f'{pct:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                  fontsize=9.5, color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4)
    bottoms += np.array(vals)

total_1990 = sum(totals[1990].values())
total_2024 = sum(totals[2024].values())
ax_a.text(x[0], bottoms[0] + 15, f'{total_1990:.0f}M', ha='center', va='bottom',
          fontsize=10, color=TEXT_DK, fontweight='bold')
ax_a.text(x[1], bottoms[1] + 15, f'{total_2024:.0f}M', ha='center', va='bottom',
          fontsize=10, color=TEXT_DK, fontweight='bold')

ax_a.set_xlim(-0.4, 1.4)
ax_a.set_ylim(0, 2750)
ax_a.set_xticks(x)
ax_a.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DK)
ax_a.set_ylabel('Millions of DALYs', fontsize=10, color=TEXT_MD)
ax_a.set_title('A  Global DALYs by Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
               color=TEXT_DK, loc='left', pad=8)
ax_a.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.6, zorder=0)
ax_a.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_a.spines[['top','right','bottom']].set_visible(False)
ax_a.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False)

ax_b.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)

    ("Stroke",                      2, "NCD"),
    ("Diabetes mellitus",           3, "NCD"),
    ("COPD",                        4, "NCD"),
    ("Neonatal preterm birth",      5, "Communicable"),
    ("Lower respiratory infections",6, "Communicable"),
    ("Low back pain",               7, "NCD"),
    ("Depressive disorders",        8, "NCD"),

# Left labels (1990)
for name, rank, cat in causes_1990:

# Right labels (2024)

ax_b.axvline(x_1990, color=GRID_C, lw=1.5, zorder=1)
ax_b.axvline(x_2024, color=GRID_C, lw=1.5, zorder=1)

ax_b.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DK)

ax_b.set_yticklabels([f'#{i}' for i in range(1, 11)], fontsize=9, color=TEXT_MD)

ax_b.xaxis.set_label_position('top')
ax_b.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, top=False)

ax_b.spines[['top','right','left','bottom']].set_visible(False)
ax_b.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PANEL C & D  – Stacked horizontal bars by income group (1990 | 2024)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Low income":          {"1990": (71.2, 19.8, 9.0), "2024": (52.8, 37.4, 9.8)},
    "Lower-middle income": {"1990": (52.4, 36.1, 11.5), "2024": (27.1, 60.5, 12.4)},
    "Upper-middle income": {"1990": (28.7, 57.3, 14.0), "2024": (11.3, 77.2, 11.5)},
    "High income":         {"1990": ( 8.3, 81.6, 10.1), "2024": ( 4.1, 87.8,  8.1)},

    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, col_idx], facecolor=PANEL_BG)

        for i, (l, v) in enumerate(zip(lefts, vals)):

        lefts += np.array(vals)

    ax.set_xlim(0, 100)

    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.spines[['top','right','left']].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(left=False)
    ax.set_xticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['0%', '25%', '50%', '75%', '100%'], fontsize=8.5, color=TEXT_MD)

            facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none')
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
